matched_stage_reward.reference_order: Hold frame[k] and robot-relative targets before action; score after eight physical substeps, before advancing reference

matched_stage_reward.PPO_return_limitation: Existing PPO recordings omit full nine-link contact forces/history. Missing reward terms are not fabricated or re-simulated.
matched_stage_reward.native_soft_limits_limitation: The mathematical stage formulas match, but MuJoCo0.95 joint-range limits are a disclosed surrogate for actual PhysX training runtime limits; historical six-leg maximum difference2.90718e-6rad. No new400Hz PhysX runtime parity test is claimed.

new_CEM_runs.initial_state_source: Only recorded PPO initial qpos/qvel; exact identity verified. No subsequent PPO state/action supplies CEM's initial plan.
new_CEM_runs.plant_match: Native mass/inertia/frame/damping/frictionloss/margin/gap/solver and friction/priority/condim/solref/solimp readbacks match saved PPO native-MuJoCo validation exactly
new_CEM_runs.prediction_reset_caveat: Prediction cold-resets qacc warmstart/time every20ms stage, while the validation plant continuously integrates; matching compiled plants does not imply identical hidden solver state.

new_CEM_runs.timing_scope: Measured end-to-end solve latency includes IPC and concurrent local CPU jobs. Not isolated, hardware-matched PPO latency; all solves exceed20ms, so this is offline control.
